onboarding.slide1_text: All your income and spending in one smart ledger. See where your money comes from and where it goes at a glance.
onboarding.slide2_text: Tap + below to log a transaction in seconds, or scan a receipt and let the amount and category fill themselves in.
onboarding.slide3_text: Switch between your personal ledger and the family one in a single tap — same budget, everyone on their own phone.
onboarding.slide4_text: Net balance, category-by-category spending, your monthly flow chart and budget usage — the dashboard reads your month for you.
onboarding.slide5_text: Download the month's summary as a PDF and export every transaction to Excel. Share it with your accountant, archive it, or dig in on your own.
onboarding.tour_hero: This is your month at a glance: money in, money out, and what's left in your pocket. Green means you're doing fine; red means you spent more than you earned.
onboarding.tour_add: The most important button in the app. Tap it to add an expense or income. Or snap a photo of your receipt — we'll fill in the amount and category for you.
onboarding.tour_transactions: All your money in and out lives in this tab: salary, groceries, bills... Whenever you wonder 'where did my money go?', look here.
onboarding.tour_budgets: Set spending limits here. Example: 'Groceries, 5,000 a month.' The bar fills as you spend; we warn you as you near the limit.
onboarding.tour_goals: Your savings goals live here. Set one like 'Vacation, 30,000' and watch the bar fill as you add money.
onboarding.tour_tx_search: Looking for a record? Type here. Example: type 'groceries' and only those show up.
onboarding.tour_tx_filter: Filter the list here: only income, only expenses, or everything.
onboarding.tour_tx_add: Tap to add a new record — both income and expenses go in here.
onboarding.tour_bg_add: Tap to set your first budget: pick a category, type a monthly limit. We'll track the rest.
onboarding.tour_gl_add: Tap to create your first goal: give it a name and an amount. Then use 'Add money' to top it up each month.
onboarding.tour_menu: Everything else is in this menu: investments, debts, subscriptions, reports... Tap 'Done' now, then tap here — we'll walk you through it.
onboarding.tour_inv: Gold, dollars, stocks, funds... add whatever you own. We'll show today's value and your profit or loss at current rates.
onboarding.tour_debt: Who you owe and who owes you — all here. Log payments with 'Add payment'; the remaining amount shrinks by itself.
onboarding.tour_rec: Set up monthly repeats like rent, salary and bills ONCE. When the day comes, the app adds them by itself — even if you forget.
onboarding.tour_pay: Type your gross salary; we'll calculate your monthly take-home pay after taxes. One tap turns it into monthly income.
onboarding.tour_cat: Categories group your spending: Groceries, Rent, Fun... Use the built-in ones or add your own with its color and icon.
onboarding.tour_hh: Invite your family here: everyone adds from their own phone, everyone sees the same picture. One shared budget, one place.
onboarding.tour_exp: Get your report here at month's end: PDF summary or Excel list. Download it, share it with your accountant, keep it.
onboarding.tour_scope: Switch ledgers here. Personal: records only you can see. If you create a family ledger, you switch to it here; everyone in it sees the same records.
onboarding.tour_privacy: Tap this eye to hide every amount — on the bus or in a café, no one peeks at your screen. Tap again to bring them back.
onboarding.tour_tx_swipe: A little secret: swipe any record LEFT with your finger. Edit, move and delete buttons appear underneath.
onboarding.tour_rec_popular: Got subscriptions like Netflix or Spotify? Tap the logo — everything comes pre-filled; just check the amount and tap Add.
onboarding.tour_rent: Rent contract up for renewal? Type your current rent and get the legal maximum increase from official CPI data in seconds.
onboarding.tour_moneyvalue: Curious what old money is worth today? Pick an amount and a date, and see its purchasing power by CPI in seconds.
onboarding.tour_calculators: Salary, severance, rent, inflation… all the Turkey-specific calculators in one place.
onboarding.tour_installments: Your card installments live here: how many are left, what hits your card this month, and when you'll breathe easier — all on one screen.
onboarding.tour_inst_hero: How much in installments hits your card this month? The answer is always here.
onboarding.tour_inst_add: Bought something in installments? Tap here, enter it once — it posts automatically every month.
onboarding.tour_golddays: Track your gold/money gün groups: whose turn, who paid, what the pot is worth.
onboarding.tour_pricealarms: Currencies, gold, crypto… set a price alarm and we will ping you when it hits.
onboarding.tour_sharedpots: Split group expenses: see who owes whom automatically and settle with the fewest transfers.
